description: Renders wireframe pages to standalone SVG strings fully headless — no browser, no JS interop — by reusing the live component visuals through WireframePageSvg.BuildFragment. Suitable for server-side preview generation, MCP, and backfill, where no DOM is available.

members.name: RenderPageAsync
members.type: Task<string> RenderPageAsync(WireframePage page, WireframeComponentScope? scope = null, WireframePageSvgOptions? options = null)
members.description: Renders a single page to an SVG string. Component definitions are resolved in scope (pass the app scope to resolve app-scoped custom components). Always returns a valid <svg> — an empty page yields a sized placeholder, never null.

members.name: RenderDocumentAsync
members.type: Task<IReadOnlyList<WireframePageRender>> RenderDocumentAsync(WireframeDocument document, WireframeComponentScope? scope = null, WireframePageSvgOptions? options = null)
members.description: Renders every page of the document in document order, returning one WireframePageRender per page.

examples.title: Render pages server-side
